Persistence for host-side preferences the emulation core cannot hold.

Almost everything the menus change lives in the core's own config struct and round-trips through its config.ini. A few settings do not: config.show_status_bar, for instance, is declared inside #if defined(_WIN32) in src/core/config.h, so it does not exist in this build at all. Rather than patch the vendored core for one boolean, those settings live here, in a small INI-style file beside config.ini.

Format is deliberately trivial - Key=Value per line, # comments, unknown keys preserved on save so a newer build's settings survive a downgrade.
